how.title: How it works
how.intro: One artwork becomes products that can be sold again and again. Every piece carries a story tag that plays a short video of the artist.
how.draw: Artists who draw take a photo. The app finds the drawing and cuts it out cleanly.
how.speak: Artists who cannot draw describe their idea out loud. The app makes the image, then reads a description back so they can change it.
how.print: When you order, we print your sticker or tote. Nothing sits in a warehouse.
how.tap: Tap the story tag with your phone to hear the artist. No app or login needed.
how.earn: The artist earns from every sale. The share is shown on every product page.

studios.title: For studios
studios.intro: Art studios for people with disabilities often sell only originals, and only locally. {brand} turns each artwork into products you can sell again and again.
studios.point1: No inventory. We print when someone orders.
studios.point2: Artists approve every listing themselves, by voice or by tap.
studios.point3: Every sale shows the artist's share. The default split is 50% artist, 30% studio, 20% production.
studios.point4: Artists who cannot draw can still create, by describing their idea out loud.
studios.contact: Want to bring your studio? Get in touch with the team, we would love to hear from you.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.intro: {brand} is built for artists with disabilities first. Here is what the app does today.
a11y.voiceFirst: Voice first: every creation step can be done by speaking, with a typing option on every screen.
a11y.spoken: Spoken descriptions: after an image is made, a written description is read aloud on your device, so you know what it shows.
a11y.captions: Captions: every story video has captions.
a11y.contrast: High contrast: the site follows your device's high-contrast setting.
a11y.targets: Large targets: buttons are at least 44 points, and main actions are 60 points tall.
a11y.keyboard: Keyboard and screen readers: every control has a label and a visible focus ring.
a11y.motion: Reduced motion: animations stop when your device asks for less motion.
a11y.feedback: Something not working for you? Tell the team and we will fix it.
